zh.text: 游戏参数页补齐 12 个条目的中文名；世界页新增 Homefront 点位预设与每种类型点位数，服务端页补海关检查与日志归档，玩法页新增「事件」与「SKINR 涂装」两个分区

en.text: The game-parameter page now names 12 more settings in Chinese: the World tab can set the Homefront population preset and sites per type, the Server tab gains the customs-inspection and log-archive settings, and the Gameplay tab gains Events and SKINR SKINs sections
